Frequently asked questions

Straight answers to the questions landlords ask most.

Management plans

In Fully Managed, GETLET orders repairs directly without prior approval, within written delegated authority. In Limited Management, GETLET asks first and work starts only after you give permission. See the plans.

No. Spending ceilings, reserves and major works rules are agreed in writing in your management agreement. They are not published on this website because they depend on the property.

Switching terms are set out in your written agreement.

Repairs

It is GETLET's stated service standard, not an independently verified guarantee, and not a promise that every issue is fixed within 24 hours. Access, parts and approvals can affect timing. See what it means.

For a gas leak, call the National Gas Emergency Service on 0800 111 999. For fire or immediate danger to life, call 999. Do not wait for a form.

GETLET uses a pre-vetted contractor network covering plumbing, heating, electrical and general repairs. Trades covered are plumbing, heating, electrical and general repairs.

Rent and fees

Tenant rent is paid into a PayProp-linked account. Work is entered as invoices, which PayProp deducts when rent arrives, and the balance is sent to the landlord. See rent collection.

Pricing is by written quotation. Our fees page explains what to compare.

The client money protection and redress arrangements that apply to your agreement are set out in your written terms of business.

Compliance

No. Certificates are arranged through specialist partner agencies, and GETLET does not carry out certified work itself. Arranging a certificate does not remove the landlord's legal duty.

No. It is general information for England only. Check current GOV.UK guidance and speak to a qualified adviser. See the compliance page.
